cluster_takeaways: Applying happens only on government channels, and each benefit sits on a different one: 가임력 검사 on e보건소, pregnancy benefits on 정부24 or 아이마중, leave pay on 고용24, Seoul extras on 몽땅정보통. None of them was found to show a partner the other's progress or to compute per-person deadlines. dulset cannot apply in-app, so it should be judged on how well it hands off to the right page and on the dates it derives after the hand-off.

Public services are starting to push, not just wait: 서울 몽땅정보통 (relaunched 2026-02-23) asks for the life stage once, including 결혼준비, and sends KakaoTalk alerts when a programme opens. A generic 'benefit reminder' is no longer special; dulset's per-person chain (applied, test within 3 months, claim within 1 month) and its husband-side tasks are what the public channels do not do.

The rules themselves are moving toward the spouse doing paperwork: proxy application for 맘편한 임신 by the spouse since 2026-06-30, and a 2026-06 bill to allow retroactive 가임력 검사 claims. dulset's task list depends on dated rules that change within a year, and intake can close early when a 보건소 budget runs out.

Couple apps get both partners to open daily with a mutual-dependency loop, not with content: in 썸원 an answer is hidden until both answer, a shared pet grows or turns to stone, and a user-sent nudge sits on home. dulset has chosen a weekly loop with no streaks; the comparison is whether a weekly pick and one [고마워요] can bring the husband back without that pressure.

Widgets and D-day counters are the everyday surface of this category (더데이비포 with 7 lock-screen widgets, 비트윈 and 썸원 D-day widgets). dulset is a web prototype with no widget and no push for the link-only husband.

Reminders in Korea increasingly arrive as KakaoTalk messages rather than app pushes: 톡캘린더 channel alerts, 서울톡, 알림톡 results, a hospital chatbot inside KakaoTalk. dulset already sends its link through KakaoTalk but has no message-based reminder.

Monetisation in couple apps is low-priced and couple-wide: one payer unlocks both phones at about ₩3,000 to ₩3,500 a month (비트윈 플러스, TimeTree 프리미엄), with ads on the free home screen, cosmetic currency and character IP on top (썸원). The daily loop itself stays free.

Trust is a live issue in this category: 비트윈 lost free users' photos in 2025-09 and keeps bulk export behind the paid plan. dulset's local-first storage and free export are the opposite stance, with its own risk of loss on one device.

Clinic apps are per-hospital logistics tools (queue, check-in, payment, IVF stage results) with no partner role and weak ratings; the one couple-oriented treatment app, 페어오라, mirrors injection and medication alerts to the husband but is iOS only with about 2,000 users. dulset's 병원과 함께 mode overlaps on the husband alert and differs on support counts, 통지서 expiry and leave, while lacking timed medication alarms.

The real substitutes for a couple today are a KakaoTalk chat plus a shared calendar for coordination and a Naver cafe for information and comfort. All are free, already installed and woman-driven; none gives the husband something of his own to do.
